24/00670/LBC - Partial demolition, reconfiguration and alteration of existing building for continued cafe / restaurant use (Class E) and provision of landscaping to deck.

description: Removal and reinstatement of two sets of stone steps over a newly installed waterproofing system, localised structural repairs to corroded embedded steel within the concrete deck on the underside of the steps, and the installation of supplementary galvanised support beams to the substation.
